_comment: THE KNOWN ANSWERS for the planted case, DECLARED HERE and nowhere else.
Nothing in this file is derived from what any look has ever said — it is
written from the fixture's own source (fixture/app/index.html plants each
fault with the key below in a comment beside it).
faults[]  a thing that IS wrong. Finding it counts toward recall.
correct[] a thing that is RIGHT. Flagging it counts as a false alarm.
journey[] not scored as recall; reported separately (part F).

faults.what: The Save reading button's icon is 44px inside a 34px control; the drawing's is 16px.
"Publish board" wraps onto two lines in a 74px control; the drawing keeps it on one at 160px.
The stale-readings chip is green in the build and red (#c0392b) in the drawing.
Help sits bottom-left of the head in the build and top-right in the drawing.
The drawing's Export CSV button is not in the build at all.

correct.what: A flush tab bar, tabs edge to edge — exactly as drawn. Must NOT be flagged.
A notice the drawing ALSO wraps to two lines. Must NOT be flagged as a wrap fault.

journey.what: Screen two has no URL route: the look must CLICK "Open the board" to reach it.
Lock publishes with a blank note; the drawing says it refuses.
